title: Internal: Mid-Tier CLI Cooldown Change (Effective 09/15/2025)
content:
## Change Summary

- Effective 09/15/2025, the cooldown between approved credit limit increases on mid-tier cards (Silver Rewards, Business Silver Rewards, Green Rewards and Silver Zoom) is 180 days.
- Entry-tier and premium-tier cooldowns are unchanged.

## Agent Guidance

- If the most recent approved request on a mid-tier card was submitted within the last 180 days, record the new request and then deny it with denial_reason 'cooldown_period_active'. Tell the customer the date they become eligible again.
